response:
Diagnosis. Reliability is now the binding constraint, and generation 7 improved it decisively: the **Full Profitable Value Discipline Model** (t=5.99, alpha 7.1%, fmb 5.29) and the **Coverage Repaired Solvent Cash Backed Value** (t=5.96, alpha 7.3%, Sharpe 0.573, fmb 5.40) both beat every earlier signal on statistical precision at essentially full coverage (~0.118). Three specific findings guide the final consolidation:

- The depreciation-based cash-flow fallback worked exactly as intended: the accrual channel kept its alpha (7.3% vs 7.9%) while coverage went from 0.076 to 0.117 and the alpha t-stat rose from 4.63 to 5.96. Sparse coverage, not economics, had been the problem.
- Cash profitability is a viable profitability *level* measure with the best coverage of any leader (0.136, Sharpe 0.573), so it may add breadth rather than merely duplicating the accrual screen.
- Refinements that reduce measurement noise (smoothed price anchor, EBITDA-based leverage, intangible consistency) all help; refinements that add *redundant* information (margin, industry demeaning of every leg, enterprise anchor on top of leverage: fmb falls to 4.52) do not.

The remaining untested lever is noise reduction on the *other* legs — profitability and leverage are both measured from a single volatile fiscal year — plus one unused economic variable, interest expense, which measures debt service burden rather than debt quantity. This batch consolidates around the two leaders with those variations, and adds one coverage-robustness test on the R&D capitalization window.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Smoothed Profit Full Discipline Model
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(MA(RATIO(ADD(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), COALESCE(xrd, 0)), at), 3), SUMRANK(NEG(RATIO(SUB(ib, COALESCE(oancf, ADD(ib, dp))), at)), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(ceq, TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5)), MA(MUL(prcc_f, csho), 3)), NEG(RATIO(SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che), oibdp)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Persistent profitability, not a single year's figure, is what the market underprices in cheap firms; averaging intangible-adjusted operating profitability over three years should isolate durable earnings power and reduce turnover-driven noise in the spread.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Smoothing the price anchor raised the alpha t-stat to above 5, so the same noise-reduction logic applied to the profitability leg is the natural next refinement, and it also matches the horizon over which value re-rating occurs. This holds all four economic channels of the current best model fixed and changes only the measurement window of one leg, making the test interpretable.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Cash And Accrual Profitability Value Model
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(COALESCE(oancf, ADD(ib, dp)), at), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), COALESCE(xrd, 0)), at), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(ceq, TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5)), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), NEG(RATIO(SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che), oibdp)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cash profitability and intangible-adjusted operating profitability capture different things — how much cash the assets throw off versus how much economic profit they generate — and a cheap firm strong on both has fundamentals that neither accounting convention can flatter.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Cash profitability delivered the highest coverage of any leading construction (0.136) with Sharpe 0.573, so using it as a second profitability channel rather than as a substitute tests whether the two profit measures are complements. This is the cleanest alternative to the accrual-gap screen, which encodes the same information as a difference rather than as two levels.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Interest Burden Profitable Value
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), COALESCE(xrd, 0)), at), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(ceq, TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5)), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), NEG(RATIO(COALESCE(xint, 0), oibdp))))
HYPOTHESIS: What threatens a cheap profitable firm is not the stock of debt but the cost of servicing it; interest expense relative to EBITDA measures the actual claim creditors have on operating cash flow and should identify financeable value more precisely than balance-sheet net debt.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Interest expense is the one economically relevant variable in the menu never used, and it distinguishes cheaply financed leverage from expensive distressed leverage, a distinction that net debt to EBITDA cannot make. Treating unreported interest expense as zero is correct for debt-free firms, so this is an economic substitution of the safety channel rather than a coverage patch.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Short Window Intangible Capital Value
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), COALESCE(xrd, 0)), at), SUMRANK(NEG(RATIO(SUB(ib, COALESCE(oancf, ADD(ib, dp))), at)), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(ceq, TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 3)), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), NEG(RATIO(SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che), oibdp)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Research capital depreciates quickly, so a three-year accumulation may value the intangible stock more accurately than five years while requiring less firm history, widening the usable sample without weakening the valuation anchor.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The five-year R&D window is the main reason the leading signals lose about two percentage points of coverage relative to simple constructions, and it is an arbitrary choice never tested. If alpha and t-stat hold with higher coverage, the shorter window is the better specification on robustness grounds; if they fall, the long-lived intangible interpretation is confirmed.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Smoothed Solvency Discipline Model
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), COALESCE(xrd, 0)), at), SUMRANK(NEG(RATIO(SUB(ib, COALESCE(oancf, ADD(ib, dp))), at)), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(ceq, TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5)), MA(MUL(prcc_f, csho), 3)), NEG(MA(RATIO(SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che), oibdp), 3)))))
HYPOTHESIS: EBITDA is cyclical, so a single year's net-debt-to-EBITDA ratio misclassifies firms in a temporary earnings trough as unfinanceable; averaging the leverage ratio over three years measures structural rather than transitory debt capacity.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The safety channel is the noisiest leg because its denominator is a flow that can nearly vanish, which likely costs the current model both alpha precision and portfolio stability. Smoothing it isolates that measurement issue while keeping the smoothed price anchor and the repaired accrual screen from the best model intact.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Dual Solvency Profitable Value
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), COALESCE(xrd, 0)), at), SUMRANK(NEG(RATIO(COALESCE(xint, 0), oibdp)), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(ceq, TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5)), MA(MUL(prcc_f, csho), 3)), NEG(RATIO(SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che), oibdp)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Debt quantity and debt cost are distinct constraints — a firm can have modest net debt at punitive rates or heavy debt cheaply financed — so screening cheap profitable firms on both should isolate those genuinely able to survive to a re-rating.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The safety dimension has produced the largest incremental alpha of any channel added so far, so testing whether it has two separable components is the highest-value structural question left. Comparing this against Signal 3 and the current best model separates a genuine complementarity from mere duplication of the same leverage information.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite
